title: He Tried to Scream—Only Code Came Out | ECHO//100 Episode 7
description: Kavi loses his voice to binary glitches as he and Byte navigate a world drained of color. They discover their survival hinges on the rhythmic humming of the forbidden Red Door. Episode 7 of ECHO//100: ARC. This is an AI-assisted original fiction work.

scenes.text: Kavi tries to scream, but only jagged lines of blue binary code escape his throat.
scenes.caption: Binary voice glitch
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi wearing a red hoodie and glasses, mouth open, emitting glowing blue binary code, grayscale background.

scenes.text: The neighborhood has turned monochrome, but the hovering Null entity scans for any sudden movement.
scenes.caption: Null patrols grayscale
scenes.image_prompt: Null, a black-purple glitch figure with red eyes, scanning a colorless suburban street.

scenes.text: Byte vibrates with anxiety, his cyan face flickering as he hides behind a concrete pillar.
scenes.caption: Byte hiding fear
scenes.image_prompt: Byte, a white floating robot with an orange antenna and cyan face, pressed against a wall.

scenes.text: A low hum echoes nearby, drawing Null toward the hidden, pulsing silhouette of the Red Door.
scenes.caption: The humming door
scenes.image_prompt: A glowing red door frame standing in a gray alley, emitting visible sound waves.

scenes.text: Kavi realizes the stillness protects them; they must mimic the static world to survive Null.
scenes.caption: Frozen in place
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi and Byte standing perfectly still while Null passes inches away, eyes glowing red.

scenes.text: Mira appears, revealing that Kavi’s future self creates the grayscale to cloak their every move.
scenes.caption: Future Kavi's cloak
scenes.image_prompt: Mira in a blue holographic teal coat pointing at Kavi, grayscale world warping around them.

scenes.text: The humming intensifies, but Mira notices the door isn't opening; it is being sealed shut.
scenes.caption: Door sealing shut
scenes.image_prompt: The Red Door surface rippling as if being pulled into a vacuum from behind.

scenes.text: Mira screams a warning: something from the other side is pushing the door closed forever.
scenes.caption: Closing the gate
scenes.image_prompt: Mira looking horrified at the Red Door, which is shrinking rapidly into a pinprick.
